audience: compliance teams that run KYC and AML checks on clients in ComplyCube

useCases.title: Find checks that need attention
useCases.text: List checks filtered by outcome, such as attention, or by client or status. Open one check to read the outcome of each part.

useCases.title: Look up a client record
useCases.text: List clients, newest first, or open one client by id to read its contact and personal or company details.

useCases.title: Create a client and run an AML screen
useCases.text: Create a person or company client, then run a standard or extensive AML screening check. Each check counts against the monthly quota. Read the result later with the check id.
